messages.subject: Rashid — first read on the grievance
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

I've been through the grievance and his 2019 service agreement. Two things jump out: (1) the 'restructuring' looks thin — there's a real risk a tribunal finds it's a sham, especially if they really did approach an external candidate; and (2) the CEO's reported comments ('different kind of energy', 'think about your future') are squarely age-discrimination territory. The whistleblowing point on rebates is weaker but adds settlement value.

I'll draft an advice note with a recommended financial range. Leaning towards a protected conversation under s.111A.

Tom

messages.plaintextBody:
I've pulled the September 2024 board pack — it actually commends Rashid for 11% growth in distribution. That cuts against any performance narrative, so we should steer the client towards redundancy/SOSR framing rather than performance. Will add to the note.

Elena
